scope: Source-anchored spelling correction for explicitly marked complete multiword note phrases, propagated through the existing save_note transaction. No ASR decoder, model, GPU recipe or installer change.

behavior.admission: 3–6 ASCII alphabetic words; one long-word mismatch with two or more exact anchors; existing edit-distance, length and shared-affix limits. Conflicting names, ambiguous or overlapping phrases, absent names, Unicode/identifier boundaries and budget overflow abstain.
behavior.permissions: Independent spelling-only ownership. No global writer/caption name obligations. All-uppercase marked phrases no longer leak component-word name permissions.
behavior.synchronization: Original ASR and article history retained; source, cited quote/revision and supported article spelling update atomically. Human edits remain authoritative. Removing context restores archived ASR and marks the old article stale. Supported paraphrase spelling does not certify its facts.
behavior.resources: No added model jobs. Extra declared-name scan/guard construction is lazy and skipped without an eligible phrase. No measured whole-app resource claim.

validation.save_note_red_green: Four tests failed on unchanged production text, then passed after the fix. Full regression exposed uppercase component-name leakage; fixed with whole marked-span extraction. Initial compile error in a new SQLite test was fixed (usize to i64).

frozen_replay.baseline: Existing compiled 6a8c00f CLI reproduced all 300 frozen corrected outputs without changes.
frozen_replay.harness_initial_error: First baseline comparison joined passages with newlines while the original report used spaces; per-segment comparison and identical aggregate joins fixed the harness. Both failed and corrected reports retained.

limits: Frozen public English read-speech outputs, not new acoustic inference, live microphone, Chinese/code-switching, natural meetings or physical GPU validation.
Two recovered source spellings do not solve arbitrary phonetic errors, the 51 remaining positive misses or general ASR calibration.
Q16 mixed-language minutes generation remains failed; no new generation attempt or release admission in this slice.
CUDA/Vulkan archives remain separately distributed; existing package recipes and signed components unchanged.
Stable remains v0.3.4; v0.3.5 is not published.
